en: a way of pronouncing words in a region
toeic: The new manager speaks English with a strong accent.
toeic_zh: 新經理說英語帶有濃厚的口音。

en: able to be easily reached or entered; easy to obtain
simple: Our customer support is easily accessible online.
simple_zh: 我們的客支持在線上很容易訪問。
toeic: Accessible customer service channels include phone, email, and live chat.
toeic_zh: 可訪問的客服渠道包括電話、電郵和即時聊天。

en: to support or follow closely; to stick firmly
simple: Adhere to company service standards at all times.
simple_zh: 始終堅持公司服務標準。
toeic: Adhere strictly to ethical practices in customer interactions.
toeic_zh: 在顧客互動中嚴格堅持倫理實踐。

en: saying yes or showing agreement
toeic: We received an affirmative reply from the client this morning.
toeic_zh: 我們今天早上收到客戶肯定的回覆。

en: as another choice or possibility
simple: Take a bus, or alternatively, a taxi.
toeic: You can pay by card or, alternatively, in cash.
toeic_zh: 您可以刷卡付款，或者付現金。

en: a person who gives news or information on air
toeic: The announcer asked passengers to go to gate twelve.
toeic_zh: 廣播員請乘客前往十二號登機門。

en: to make someone a little angry
toeic: Long waiting times may annoy customers and hurt our reputation.
toeic_zh: 漫長的等待時間可能惹惱顧客並損害我們的聲譽。

en: at any time you want
toeic: Customers can cancel their subscription anytime online.
toeic_zh: 客戶可以隨時在線上取消訂閱。

en: words that say you are sorry
toeic: The company issued a public apology for the billing error.
toeic_zh: 公司針對帳單錯誤發表了公開道歉。
family: apology (n); apologize (v) for; make/offer an apology to；apologetic (adj)

en: thanks, or a feeling of gratitude
simple: She showed her appreciation with a card.
simple_zh: 她用一張卡片表達感謝。
toeic: The manager gave a gift in appreciation of our hard work.
toeic_zh: 經理送了禮物，感謝我們的辛勤工作。

en: a promise that something will be true
toeic: The supplier gave us assurance that the goods will arrive on time.
toeic_zh: 供應商向我們保證貨物會準時送達。

en: to wait for something
toeic: We eagerly await your confirmation of the order.
toeic_zh: 我們熱切等候您確認訂單。

en: used in 'on behalf of' to mean for someone
simple: I spoke on behalf of my team.
toeic: I am writing on behalf of the entire sales department.
toeic_zh: 我謹代表整個業務部門來信。

en: To look through things casually without a fixed aim.
simple: I like to browse the shop.
toeic: Customers can browse our full catalog on the website.
toeic_zh: 顧客可在網站上瀏覽我們的完整型錄。

en: A short official announcement or news report.
simple: Read the bulletin on the wall.
toeic: The company bulletin lists all upcoming training sessions.
toeic_zh: 公司公告列出了所有即將舉行的訓練課程。

en: A casual word you say when leaving.
toeic: She said bye to the clients and left the office.
toeic_zh: 她向客戶道別後離開了辦公室。

en: a person who makes a phone call
simple: The caller wants to speak to you.
toeic: Please ask each caller for an account number before checking the order.
toeic_zh: 查詢訂單前，請先向每位來電者詢問帳號。

en: A small phone you can carry anywhere.
simple: My cellphone is on the table.
toeic: Please turn off your cellphone during the presentation.
toeic_zh: 簡報期間請關閉您的手機。

en: To move around, or pass from person to person.
toeic: Please circulate the agenda to all team members before Monday.
toeic_zh: 請在週一前將議程傳給所有團隊成員。

en: to make something clear or easier to understand
simple: Can you clarify what you mean by that?
toeic: Service representatives clarify product specifications to prevent misunderstandings.
toeic_zh: 服務代表澄清產品規格以防止誤解。

en: A piece of information that helps solve a problem.
toeic: The survey gave us a clue about customer needs.
toeic_zh: 這項調查讓我們對顧客需求有了線索。

en: to pay someone money or give them something to make up for loss or damage
simple: We will compensate you for the damaged goods.
simple_zh: 我們將為損壞的商品補償您。
toeic: Customers who suffered damages are entitled to compensate through insurance claims.
toeic_zh: 遭受損害的顧客有權通過保險索賠獲得補償。

en: a kind thing you say about someone
toeic: Customers often leave a compliment about our friendly staff in the survey.
toeic_zh: 顧客常在問卷中稱讚我們友善的員工。

en: intended to be kept secret or private; not for public disclosure
simple: Treat all customer information as confidential.
simple_zh: 將所有顧客信息視為機密。
toeic: Confidential customer data requires secure storage and limited access.
toeic_zh: 機密顧客數據需要安全存儲和有限訪問。

en: To tell someone you are happy about their success.
toeic: I would like to congratulate the team on a successful launch.
toeic_zh: 我要恭喜團隊成功完成產品上市。

en: A message of praise for someone's success.
toeic: A congratulation card was sent to the new manager.
toeic_zh: 一張賀卡被寄給了新任經理。

en: thinking about the feelings of other people
toeic: It was considerate of you to reschedule the meeting for me.
toeic_zh: 你體貼地為我重新安排會議，真是貼心。

en: the quality of being easy or useful
simple: The store is open late for your convenience.
simple_zh: 商店很晚才關門，方便你。
toeic: Please return the form at your earliest convenience.
toeic_zh: 請在您方便時盡早寄回表格。

en: fitting in well with a person's needs; not troublesome
simple: Our store hours are very convenient for customers.
simple_zh: 我們的營業時間對顧客來說很方便。
toeic: Online shopping provides convenient access to products 24/7.
toeic_zh: 在線購物提供24/7方便的產品訪問。

en: to communicate or express an idea, feeling, or information
simple: Convey important information clearly to customers.
simple_zh: 向顧客清楚地傳達重要信息。
toeic: Convey service limitations clearly to manage customer expectations.
toeic_zh: 清楚地傳達服務限制以管理顧客期望。

en: a change that fixes a mistake
toeic: Please make the necessary corrections and resubmit the report by Friday.
toeic_zh: 請做必要的修正，並於週五前重新提交報告。

en: in a way that is right
toeic: Please make sure the form is filled out correctly before submitting it.
toeic_zh: 送出前請確認表格填寫正確。

en: letters or emails sent and received
simple: I answer my correspondence each morning.
toeic: All correspondence should be addressed to the customer service department.
toeic_zh: 所有信件應寄給客服部門。

en: polite behavior or a free favor
simple_zh: 他很有禮貌地向她道謝。
toeic: The shuttle bus is provided as a courtesy to hotel guests.
toeic_zh: 接駁巴士是提供給飯店房客的免費服務。

en: the hours when it is light
toeic: Call our daytime hotline between nine and five for assistance.
toeic_zh: 請於九點至五點致電我們的日間專線尋求協助。

en: a fault or imperfection in something
simple: The product has a manufacturing defect.
toeic: Defects discovered within the warranty period are covered under our guarantee.
toeic_zh: 在保修期內發現的缺陷由我們的保證覆蓋。

en: imperfect or faulty; not working as it should
simple: The defective product was recalled by the manufacturer.
simple_zh: 製造商召回了有缺陷的產品。
toeic: Defective merchandise returned within the policy timeframe receives replacements.
toeic_zh: 在政策時間內退回的有缺陷的商品可獲得更換。

en: to identify the cause or nature of a problem by examination
simple: We need to diagnose the problem first.
simple_zh: 我們首先需要診斷問題。
toeic: Diagnose customer issues promptly through systematic questioning and testing.
toeic_zh: 通過系統提問和測試及時診斷顧客問題。

en: to press numbers on a phone
toeic: To reach the operator, please dial zero from any hotel phone.
toeic_zh: 若要聯絡總機，請用任何飯店電話撥零。

en: a person eating at a restaurant; a small cheap restaurant
toeic: Each diner will receive a free drink with the set menu.
toeic_zh: 每位用餐者點套餐都將獲得一杯免費飲料。

en: a list of names, addresses or files
toeic: You can find her extension in the company directory.
toeic_zh: 你可以在公司通訊錄中找到她的分機號碼。

en: a sad feeling when hopes are not met
toeic: The delay in shipping was a disappointment to many customers.
toeic_zh: 出貨延遲令許多顧客感到失望。

en: a strong feeling of dislike
simple: He showed disgust at the smell.
simple_zh: 他對那個味道感到噁心。
toeic: The customer expressed disgust at the dirty restaurant kitchen.
toeic_zh: 顧客對餐廳骯髒的廚房表示厭惡。

en: to not enjoy something
toeic: Many customers dislike waiting in long lines at the counter.
toeic_zh: 許多顧客不喜歡在櫃台排長隊等候。

en: to make someone unhappy with something
simple_zh: 服務慢可能讓客人不滿。
toeic: Long delays dissatisfy customers and harm the company's reputation.
toeic_zh: 長時間延誤會讓顧客不滿並損害公司聲譽。

en: a newspaper article giving the paper's opinion
simple: I read the editorial this morning.
toeic: The editorial praised the city's new recycling program.
toeic_zh: 這篇社論稱讚了市政府的新資源回收計畫。

en: to put something inside an envelope or area
simple: I enclose a photo with this letter.
simple_zh: 我在這封信裡附上一張照片。
toeic: Please enclose a copy of your résumé with the application.
toeic_zh: 請在申請書中附上履歷影本。

en: giving you pleasure or fun
toeic: We hope your stay at our resort is enjoyable.
toeic_zh: 我們希望您在本度假村住得愉快。

en: feeling or showing strong interest and excitement
toeic: Customers were enthusiastic about the new product line.
toeic_zh: 顧客對新產品系列反應熱烈。

en: unusually good or special
toeic: The hotel is known for its exceptional customer service.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店以卓越的客戶服務聞名。

en: only, without including others
simple: This room is exclusively for staff.
simple_zh: 這個房間只限員工使用。
toeic: The sale is available exclusively to registered members.
toeic_zh: 這次特賣僅限註冊會員。

en: to come to an end; to become no longer valid or usable
simple: The warranty will expire next month.
toeic: Expired warranties no longer provide coverage for product defects.
toeic_zh: 過期保修不再為產品缺陷提供保障。

en: giving information to make something clear
toeic: An explanatory brochure is included with every package.
toeic_zh: 每個包裹都附有一份說明手冊。

en: based on facts and real information
simple: The report is factual and clear.
toeic: Please make sure the article is factual before you publish it.
toeic_zh: 發表前請確認這篇文章屬實。

en: a small fault or imperfection in something
simple: There is a small flaw in the glass.
toeic: Flaws discovered during quality inspection prevent defects reaching customers.
toeic_zh: 質量檢查中發現的缺陷可防止缺陷到達顧客。

en: to cause someone to feel annoyed or upset by preventing success
simple: Technical problems frustrate many online shoppers.
simple_zh: 技術問題讓許多在線購物者沮喪。
toeic: Frustrate customer anger by offering immediate compensation.
toeic_zh: 通過提供即時補償來消除顧客的憤怒沮喪。

en: a broad statement based on a few examples
toeic: It is a generalization to say all customers prefer lower prices.
toeic_zh: 說所有顧客都偏好低價是一種以偏概全。

en: freely giving more than is necessary or expected; ample
simple: Our generous return policy satisfies most customers.
simple_zh: 我們慷慨的退貨政策滿足大多數顧客。
toeic: Generous discounts and loyalty rewards encourage repeat purchases.
toeic_zh: 慷慨的折扣和忠誠度獎勵鼓勵重複購買。

en: a source of danger; a potential source of risk or harm
toeic: Hazard assessment ensures customer safety standards.
toeic_zh: 危險評估確保顧客安全標準。

en: a pain in your head; a problem
toeic: The delayed shipment became a major headache for the sales team.
toeic_zh: 延遲的貨運成了業務團隊的一大麻煩。

en: by this statement or document, formally
toeic: We hereby confirm receipt of your order dated March 3.
toeic_zh: 我們特此確認收到您三月三日的訂單。

en: slow to act because you are not sure
toeic: Many investors are hesitant to buy shares in the new company.
toeic_zh: 許多投資人對購買這家新公司的股票持猶豫態度。

en: a short pause before doing something because of doubt
toeic: Please contact us without hesitation if you have any questions.
toeic_zh: 若有任何問題，請不要猶豫，直接與我們聯絡。

en: having no place to live
simple_zh: 那位無家可歸的男子需要食物。
toeic: The company donated blankets to help homeless families this winter.
toeic_zh: 公司捐贈毛毯，協助今年冬天無家可歸的家庭。

en: in a truthful way
toeic: Honestly, we cannot complete the project before the deadline.
toeic_zh: 老實說，我們無法在期限前完成這個專案。

en: friendly and generous treatment of guests
toeic: The hotel is known for its warm hospitality and fast service.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店以熱情款待與快速服務聞名。

en: a phone number for quick help or information
simple_zh: 請撥打服務專線尋求協助。
toeic: Customers with billing questions can call the hotline any time of day.
toeic_zh: 有帳單問題的顧客可隨時撥打服務專線。

en: the strong effect or influence of something; to have a strong effect on
simple: Positive service impacts customer lifetime value.
simple_zh: 正面服務影響顧客終身價值。
toeic: Impact analysis reveals service improvements' business benefits.
toeic_zh: 影響分析揭示服務改進的業務利益。

en: unable to wait calmly for something
simple_zh: 那位男士看起來很不耐煩。
toeic: Callers who are impatient often hang up after five minutes on hold.
toeic_zh: 不耐煩的來電者常在等候五分鐘後掛斷。

en: arriving or coming in
toeic: The receptionist handles all incoming calls and visitors.
toeic_zh: 接待員負責處理所有來電和訪客。

en: a small problem or trouble that makes things difficult
toeic: We apologize for any inconvenience caused by the system outage.
toeic_zh: 對於系統中斷所造成的任何不便，我們深表歉意。
family: inconvenience (n/v); inconvenient (adj) 不方便的；cause inconvenience；apologize for the inconvenience

en: to experience or have to pay something unpleasant
simple_zh: 您可能要承擔額外費用。
toeic: Customers will incur a fee if they cancel after the deadline.
toeic_zh: 客戶若在期限後取消，將須負擔費用。

en: giving useful information
toeic: The informative brochure explains all of our services clearly.
toeic_zh: 這份資訊豐富的小冊子清楚說明了我們所有的服務。

en: to ask a question or seek information about something
simple: Customers can inquire about product availability online.
simple_zh: 顧客可以在線詢問產品可用性。
toeic: Please inquire about our premium membership benefits at the service desk.
toeic_zh: 請在服務台詢問我們的高級會員福利。

en: the rise and fall of your voice when speaking
toeic: Good intonation helps customers understand your tone on the phone.
toeic_zh: 良好的語調有助於顧客在電話中理解您的語氣。

en: extremely useful or important
toeic: Your advice has been invaluable to our team.
toeic_zh: 您的建議對我們團隊極其寶貴。

en: to make someone annoyed
toeic: Long waiting times can irritate customers and hurt our reputation.
toeic_zh: 過長的等候時間可能惹惱顧客並損害我們的聲譽。

en: The work of collecting and writing news
toeic: She started a career in journalism after graduation.
toeic_zh: 她畢業後開始從事新聞業。

en: having a lot of knowledge or information about something
simple: Our knowledgeable staff can help you choose the right product.
simple_zh: 我們知識淵博的工作人員可以幫助您選擇合適的產品。
toeic: Knowledgeable representatives provide accurate information about product features.
toeic_zh: 知識淵博的代表提供關於產品功能的準確信息。

en: In the same way
simple: He smiled, and I did likewise.
toeic: Please sign the form and ask your manager to do likewise.
toeic_zh: 請在表格上簽名，並請你的經理也這樣做。

en: With a lot of sound
simple: He spoke loudly in the room.
toeic: Please do not talk loudly in the quiet reading area.
toeic_zh: 請勿在安靜閱讀區大聲交談。

en: A polite way to address a woman
toeic: Thank you for calling, ma'am, how may I help you?
toeic_zh: 女士，感謝您來電，請問有什麼能為您服務？

en: a failure to work normally or properly
simple: Report any product malfunction to customer service.
simple_zh: 向客服報告任何產品故障。
toeic: Malfunctioning products are covered under our extended warranty.
toeic_zh: 故障產品由我們的延長保修承保。

en: to make something as large or as great as possible
simple: Maximize customer satisfaction through excellent service.
simple_zh: 通過優秀服務最大化顧客滿意度。
toeic: Maximize operational efficiency without compromising service quality.
toeic_zh: 最大化運營效率而不損害服務質量。

en: Having a clear and important purpose
simple_zh: 她想要一份有意義的工作。
toeic: The survey gave us meaningful feedback from customers.
toeic_zh: 這項調查讓我們獲得客戶有意義的回饋。

en: TV, newspapers and the internet that give news
toeic: The company will advertise through social media.
toeic_zh: 公司將透過社群媒體進行宣傳。

en: to reduce something to the smallest possible amount or degree
simple: Minimize customer waiting times through efficient systems.
simple_zh: 通過高效系統最小化顧客等待時間。
toeic: Minimize service disruptions through proactive maintenance.
toeic_zh: 通過主動維護最小化服務中斷。

en: To wrongly say who or what someone is
toeic: Staff may misidentify the item if the label is unclear.
toeic_zh: 如果標籤不清楚，員工可能會誤認該物品。

en: to make someone believe something that is not true
simple_zh: 這個標誌可能誤導人們。
toeic: Advertisements must not mislead customers about the price.
toeic_zh: 廣告不得就價格誤導顧客。

en: A polite title for a man
toeic: Please give this report to mister Chen at reception.
toeic_zh: 請把這份報告交給接待處的陳先生。

en: to ask for too much money
toeic: Please contact us if you think we overcharge you.
toeic_zh: 如果您認為我們多收了費用，請與我們聯絡。

en: to fail to notice or consider something
toeic: Please do not overlook the warranty terms listed on page two.
toeic_zh: 請別忽略第二頁所列的保固條款。

en: a thin booklet with information
toeic: The clinic gives every visitor a pamphlet about healthy eating.
toeic_zh: 診所給每位訪客一本健康飲食的小冊子。

en: to say something again in other words
toeic: Try to paraphrase the customer's request to confirm you understand.
toeic_zh: 試著改述客戶的需求以確認你理解了。

en: a secret word you use to enter an account
toeic: Click the link below to reset your password if you cannot log in.
toeic_zh: 若無法登入，請點擊下方連結重設您的密碼。

en: ability to wait calmly
toeic: Customer service staff need patience when handling complaints.
toeic_zh: 客服人員處理客訴時需要有耐心。

en: a regular customer of a shop or restaurant
simple: He is a patron of this cafe.
simple_zh: 他是這家咖啡店的常客。
toeic: The restaurant offers a free dessert to every patron on their birthday.
toeic_zh: 餐廳在每位老主顧生日時贈送免費甜點。

en: a written request signed by many people
toeic: Residents submitted a petition to stop the new road.
toeic_zh: 居民提出請願書，要求停止興建新道路。

en: a person trained to prepare medicine
toeic: The pharmacist explained how to take the medicine.
toeic_zh: 藥師說明了這種藥的服用方式。

en: seeming likely to be true
toeic: The manager gave a plausible reason for the delay.
toeic_zh: 經理對延誤提出了合理的原因。

en: showing good manners toward other people
toeic: Always be polite and clear when you answer customer emails.
toeic_zh: 回覆客戶電子郵件時，務必保持禮貌且清楚。

en: in a bad way
simple: He did poorly on the test.
toeic: The poorly designed website frustrated many customers.
toeic_zh: 設計不良的網站讓許多顧客感到沮喪。

en: the state of being liked by many
toeic: The popularity of online shopping keeps growing each year.
toeic_zh: 網路購物的普及度逐年成長。

en: a large printed notice or picture
simple: The poster is on the wall.
toeic: We will put up a poster to promote the new product.
toeic_zh: 我們會張貼海報來宣傳新產品。

en: in a skilled, businesslike way
toeic: The staff handled the complaint professionally and politely.
toeic_zh: 員工以專業又禮貌的方式處理了客訴。

en: used to advertise a product
simple_zh: 我們寄出了促銷電子郵件。
toeic: The promotional campaign increased sales by twenty percent.
toeic_zh: 這項促銷活動使銷售增加了百分之二十。

en: to make something known to the public
toeic: The firm will publicize its new product at the trade show.
toeic_zh: 公司將在商展上宣傳其新產品。

en: an officer who looks after passengers and money
toeic: The purser announced that the flight would be delayed.
toeic_zh: 事務長宣布班機將延誤。

en: a question, often asking for information
simple: I have a query about my bill.
toeic: The customer sent a query about the delivery date.
toeic_zh: 顧客寄來詢問交貨日期的信件。

en: to make someone feel less worried
simple: I try to reassure my mom.
toeic: The agent tried to reassure the customer that the order would arrive on time.
toeic_zh: 客服人員努力向客戶保證訂單會準時送達。

en: the place where visitors are met and checked in
toeic: Please leave any complaints in writing at reception before you check out.
toeic_zh: 退房前如有投訴，請以書面留在接待處。

en: able to be paid back to you
toeic: The deposit is refundable if you cancel within seven days.
toeic_zh: 若您在七天內取消，訂金可以退還。

en: not willing to do something
toeic: Many customers are reluctant to share personal data online.
toeic_zh: 許多顧客不願在網路上分享個人資料。

en: the act of making something valid again
toeic: Your membership renewal must be completed before December 1.
toeic_zh: 您的會員續約必須在十二月一日前完成。

en: again and again
toeic: Customers have repeatedly asked for a faster delivery option.
toeic_zh: 顧客一再要求更快速的配送選項。

en: a person who answers a survey
simple_zh: 每位受訪者回答了十個問題。
toeic: Most respondents said they were satisfied with the service.
toeic_zh: 大多數受訪者表示對服務感到滿意。

en: saying something again in a clear way
simple: I need a restatement of the rule.
simple_zh: 我需要這條規則的重述。
toeic: The report included a restatement of last year's earnings.
toeic_zh: 報告中包含對去年盈餘的重新表述。

en: a man whose job is to sell things
simple: The salesman showed me a car.
simple_zh: 業務員帶我看了一輛車。
toeic: The salesman called to confirm our order for office chairs.
toeic_zh: 業務員來電確認我們訂購辦公椅的訂單。

en: in a way that is honest and truly meant
toeic: We sincerely apologize for the late delivery of your order.
toeic_zh: 對於您的訂單延遲送達，我們由衷致歉。
family: sincerely (adv); sincere (adj) 真誠的；sincerity (n)；Yours sincerely 謹啟

en: to pay to receive a service regularly
toeic: Customers can subscribe to our newsletter on the website.
toeic_zh: 顧客可以在網站上訂閱我們的電子報。

en: a person who pays for a regular service
toeic: The magazine has over ten thousand subscribers.
toeic_zh: 這本雜誌有超過一萬名訂閱者。

en: to take someone to court
toeic: The customer threatened to sue the company for damages.
toeic_zh: 這位顧客威脅要控告公司求償。

en: of very high quality
toeic: The hotel offers superb service and a beautiful view.
toeic_zh: 這間飯店提供一流的服務和美麗的景色。

en: a person who makes or fixes clothes
toeic: The tailor can adjust the jacket by tomorrow.
toeic_zh: 裁縫師明天前可以修改好這件外套。

en: a bank worker who handles customers' money
toeic: Please give your deposit slip to the teller.
toeic_zh: 請把存款單交給櫃員。

en: very good or excellent
toeic: The team did a terrific job on the presentation.
toeic_zh: 團隊的簡報做得非常出色。

en: a text changed into another language
toeic: The translation of the manual will be ready by Friday.
toeic_zh: 手冊的翻譯將在週五前完成。

en: a person who changes words into another language
toeic: We hired a translator for the international conference.
toeic_zh: 我們為國際會議聘請了一位翻譯人員。

en: very large or great
toeic: The new product has been a tremendous success.
toeic_zh: 這項新產品取得了極大的成功。

en: Not happy; sad or not satisfied.
simple_zh: 那個孩子看起來不開心。
toeic: Unhappy customers should be directed to the service desk.
toeic_zh: 不滿意的顧客應被引導至服務台。

en: Not nice or enjoyable.
simple: The room has an unpleasant smell.
simple_zh: 房間有令人不舒服的味道。
toeic: The hotel refunded us after our unpleasant experience.
toeic_zh: 在我們經歷不愉快的住宿後，飯店退款給我們。

en: Not certain about something.
simple: I am unsure about the answer.
toeic: Customers who are unsure about sizes can call our hotline.
toeic_zh: 對尺寸不確定的顧客可以撥打我們的專線。

en: Spoken, not written.
toeic: A verbal agreement is not enough; please sign the contract.
toeic_zh: 口頭協議不夠，請簽署合約。

en: A man who serves food in a restaurant.
simple_zh: 服務生送來了我們的湯。
toeic: The waiter recommended the fish special to our clients.
toeic_zh: 服務生向我們的客戶推薦了特餐魚料理。

en: To choose not to require something.
toeic: The bank agreed to waive the late payment fee this month.
toeic_zh: 銀行同意本月免收逾期付款費用。

en: required to explain and justify one's actions; responsible
simple: We hold staff accountable for service quality.
simple_zh: 我們對工作人員的服務質量負責。
toeic: Accountable employees take ownership of customer satisfaction.
toeic_zh: 負責任的員工擁有顧客滿意度的所有權。

en: a failure when a machine or system stops working
toeic: A system breakdown delayed all online orders on Monday.
toeic_zh: 系統故障使週一所有線上訂單延遲。

en: the ability to do something successfully or efficiently
simple: Demonstrate competence in your customer interactions.
simple_zh: 在顧客互動中展示能力。
toeic: Competence assessment identifies training needs for staff.
toeic_zh: 能力評估識別員工的培訓需求。

en: something given up to settle an argument
toeic: The company made a concession and agreed to cover the repair costs.
toeic_zh: 公司讓步，同意負擔維修費用。

en: to recognize or make a distinction between things; to make different
simple_zh: 區別您的服務與競爭對手。
toeic: Differentiate through personalized customer service excellence.
toeic_zh: 通過個性化客服卓越進行區別。

en: a difficult situation where a choice must be made between undesirable options
simple: The dilemma is between cost and customer satisfaction.
simple_zh: 困境在於成本和顧客滿意度之間。
toeic: Dilemma resolution requires careful weighing of consequences.
toeic_zh: 困境解決需要仔細權衡後果。

en: the process of combining parts or elements into a whole
simple: Integration of systems improves service efficiency.
simple_zh: 系統集成提高服務效率。
toeic: Integration of customer data across departments enables holistic service.
toeic_zh: 跨部門顧客數據集成實現整體服務。

en: to come between and help resolve a situation; to take action to influence events
simple: Management will intervene in complex cases.
simple_zh: 管理層將在複雜案件中進行干預。
toeic: Intervene when frontline staff cannot resolve customer issues.
toeic_zh: 當前線員工無法解決顧客問題時進行干預。

en: legally responsible for something; subject to a penalty
simple: The company is liable for product defects.
toeic: Liable parties must compensate customers for verified damages.
toeic_zh: 有責任方必須為經證實的損害賠償顧客。

en: a thing that blocks one's way or prevents or hinders progress
simple: Remove obstacles to better customer service.
toeic: Obstacles in service delivery should be identified and addressed.
toeic_zh: 應識別和解決服務交付中的障礙。

en: waiting to be decided or completed
toeic: Your refund is pending and should be completed within five business days.
toeic_zh: 您的退款正在處理中，應會在五個工作天內完成。

en: the state of being free from public attention or intrusion; confidentiality
simple: We respect your privacy and protect your personal information.
simple_zh: 我們尊重您的隱私並保護您的個人信息。
toeic: Privacy policies must clearly explain customer data usage practices.
toeic_zh: 隱私政策必須清楚解釋顧客數據使用慣例。

en: a line of people or things waiting; a list of items waiting to be processed
simple: Please wait in the queue for the next available representative.
simple_zh: 請在隊列中等待下一位可用的代表。
toeic: Queue management systems help reduce customer waiting times.
toeic_zh: 隊列管理系統有助於減少顧客等待時間。

en: to improve something by small changes or additions
simple: Refine your approach based on feedback.
simple_zh: 根據反饋改進您的方法。
toeic: Refine processes to eliminate bottlenecks in service delivery.
toeic_zh: 改進流程以消除服務交付中的瓶頸。

en: a way to correct something that went wrong
simple: Tea is a remedy for a cold.
toeic: As a remedy, the store offered a free repair and an apology.
toeic_zh: 作為補救，商店提供免費維修並致歉。

en: to give one thing and receive another in exchange
toeic: You may swap the item for a different size at any branch.
toeic_zh: 您可在任何分店將商品換成不同尺寸。

en: very quickly
toeic: Our support team acts swiftly to fix any reported issue.
toeic_zh: 我們的支援團隊會迅速處理任何通報的問題。

en: The written words for a speech or video.
toeic: Please review the script before we record the training video.
toeic_zh: 錄製訓練影片前，請先審閱腳本。

en: uncomfortable or difficult to deal with
toeic: The awkward shape of the box made shipping expensive.
toeic_zh: 這個箱子形狀不便，使運費變貴。

en: a shape made by a curved line crossing itself
simple: Make a loop with the rope.
toeic: Please keep me in the loop about the shipment status.
toeic_zh: 請讓我隨時掌握出貨狀況。

en: in a way that everyone can see or know
simple: He spoke publicly about the problem.
toeic: The company publicly announced its quarterly results on Monday.
toeic_zh: 公司週一公開宣布了季度業績。

en: a secret plan to do something harmful
simple: The movie is about a conspiracy.
simple_zh: 這部電影是關於一個陰謀。
toeic: Executives denied any conspiracy to fix prices.
toeic_zh: 高階主管否認有任何操縱價格的陰謀。

en: a person who secretly gets information
simple: The movie is about a spy.
simple_zh: 這部電影是關於一名間諜。
toeic: A spy was caught stealing data from the rival firm.
toeic_zh: 一名間諜被抓到從競爭公司竊取資料。

en: allowed by law or reasonable
toeic: The customer made a legitimate complaint about the delay.
toeic_zh: 顧客對延誤提出了合理的申訴。

en: in a sad way, or unfortunately
toeic: Sadly, we cannot offer a refund after thirty days.
toeic_zh: 很遺憾，三十天後我們無法提供退款。

en: a thin mark made by something sharp
simple: There is a scratch on the car.
toeic: The customer returned the laptop because of a scratch on the screen.
toeic_zh: 顧客因螢幕上有刮痕而退回筆電。

en: according to what people say or report
toeic: The merger will reportedly be announced next week.
toeic_zh: 據報導，合併案將於下週宣布。

en: related to diplomacy; careful not to upset people
simple_zh: 她給了一個圓滑得體的回答。
toeic: The manager was diplomatic when she rejected the proposal.
toeic_zh: 經理在拒絕提案時措辭十分得體。

en: in a way that is honest and not hidden
simple: She spoke openly about her plan.
simple_zh: 她坦率地談到她的計畫。
toeic: Employees are encouraged to speak openly about workplace concerns.
toeic_zh: 公司鼓勵員工坦率說出對工作場所的疑慮。

en: very strong anger
toeic: The customer's rage calmed down after the manager apologized.
toeic_zh: 經理道歉後，客人的怒氣才平息下來。

en: in a real and honest way
toeic: We are genuinely sorry for the delay in your shipment.
toeic_zh: 對於您的貨物延誤，我們由衷感到抱歉。

en: to communicate or work with others
simple: Kids interact with each other at school.
simple_zh: 孩子們在學校彼此互動。
toeic: Sales staff interact with customers every day.
toeic_zh: 業務人員每天都與顧客互動。

en: on purpose; in a careful way
simple: He deliberately left the door open.
toeic: The error was not made deliberately, and we apologize.
toeic_zh: 這個錯誤並非故意，我們深表歉意。

en: in a way that others cannot see or hear
toeic: The manager asked to speak with him privately after the meeting.
toeic_zh: 經理要求會後和他私下談談。

en: care and understanding for someone's trouble
toeic: Please accept our sympathy for the inconvenience you experienced.
toeic_zh: 對於您所遭遇的不便，請接受我們的歉意與慰問。

en: a serious promise to do something
simple: She made a pledge to help us.
toeic: The firm made a pledge to reduce its carbon emissions by 2030.
toeic_zh: 該公司承諾在2030年前減少碳排放。

en: to cause something to start
simple: The news may spark a big debate.
simple_zh: 這則消息可能引發大辯論。
toeic: The new policy sparked complaints from many employees.
toeic_zh: 這項新政策引起許多員工的抱怨。

en: a feeling of being upset when you cannot do something
toeic: Customers expressed frustration over the long wait for support.
toeic_zh: 顧客對客服等待時間過長表達不滿。

en: clearly and fully stated
toeic: The contract contains explicit terms about late payments.
toeic_zh: 合約中有關於逾期付款的明確條款。

en: in a clear and direct way
simple: She explicitly told me to wait.
toeic: The policy explicitly forbids the use of personal email for work.
toeic_zh: 該政策明確禁止使用個人電子郵件處理工作。

en: great worry, pain or trouble
toeic: The airline offered refunds to passengers in financial distress.
toeic_zh: 航空公司為財務困難的乘客提供退款。

en: the quality of reacting quickly or strongly
toeic: Staff need cultural sensitivity when dealing with overseas clients.
toeic_zh: 員工與海外客戶往來時需要具備文化敏感度。

en: not right or true
toeic: The invoice contained an incorrect billing address.
toeic_zh: 發票上的帳單地址有誤。

en: again and again over time
toeic: Our team continually improves the product based on feedback.
toeic_zh: 我們的團隊根據意見回饋不斷改進產品。

en: the quality of being clear and easy to understand
toeic: The manager asked for clarity on the project deadlines.
toeic_zh: 經理要求釐清專案的截止日期。

en: continuing for a long time; not giving up
toeic: Persistent delays are hurting our relationship with clients.
toeic_zh: 持續的延誤正在損害我們與客戶的關係。

en: in a good way; definitely
toeic: Customers responded positively to the new service plan.
toeic_zh: 顧客對新的服務方案反應良好。

en: Not clear or exact
toeic: The contract language is too vague, so please revise it.
toeic_zh: 合約用語太含糊，請修改。

en: A person who writes letters or reports news
toeic: Our foreign correspondent filed a story from Tokyo.
toeic_zh: 我們的駐外記者從東京發回一篇報導。

en: Hard to see or understand
toeic: The instructions were so obscure that no one could follow them.
toeic_zh: 說明太晦澀，沒有人能照著做。

en: Strong anger about something unfair
simple: The price rise caused public outrage.
toeic: The new fee caused outrage among loyal customers.
toeic_zh: 新收費引起忠實顧客的憤怒。

en: The act of saying no
toeic: The supplier's refusal to lower prices delayed the contract.
toeic_zh: 供應商拒絕降價，使合約延宕。

en: A man who speaks for a group or company
toeic: A company spokesman denied the rumors about layoffs.
toeic_zh: 公司發言人否認了裁員的傳聞。

en: To cause to be, or to provide a service
simple: The rain rendered the road unsafe.
toeic: The firm will render services to clients across the country.
toeic_zh: 公司將為全國的客戶提供服務。

en: Able to be believed or trusted
toeic: The report comes from a credible source.
toeic_zh: 這份報告來自可信的消息來源。

en: in a way that is right for the situation
simple: Please dress appropriately for the party.
simple_zh: 請穿著適合派對的服裝。
toeic: All complaints will be handled appropriately by the customer service team.
toeic_zh: 所有客訴都將由客服團隊妥善處理。

en: in a correct or fair way
simple: She rightly said no to the offer.
simple_zh: 她拒絕那個提議是對的。
toeic: Customers rightly expect a quick reply to their complaints.
toeic_zh: 顧客理所當然期待客訴能迅速獲得回覆。

en: to say strongly that something is wrong
toeic: Several leaders condemn the new policy as unfair to workers.
toeic_zh: 數位領袖譴責這項新政策對工人不公平。

en: an angry meeting between opposing people
simple: There was a confrontation at the door.
toeic: The manager tried to avoid a confrontation with the angry client.
toeic_zh: 經理試圖避免與憤怒的客戶發生衝突。

en: to try very hard to achieve something
simple: We strive to do our best.
toeic: We strive to deliver every order on time.
toeic_zh: 我們力求每筆訂單都準時送達。

en: to say a word in a certain way; to declare
simple: How do you pronounce this word?
toeic: The judge will pronounce the final decision on Friday.
toeic_zh: 法官將於週五宣布最終裁決。

en: to stop something from growing or being known
simple: He tried to suppress a laugh.
toeic: The firm tried to suppress news of the product defect.
toeic_zh: 公司試圖壓下產品瑕疵的消息。

en: to weaken something slowly
toeic: Frequent delays could undermine our reputation with customers.
toeic_zh: 頻繁延誤可能損害我們在客戶心中的信譽。

en: to ask in an emotional or serious way
simple: The child began to plead for candy.
toeic: The customer pleaded with the manager for a full refund.
toeic_zh: 顧客懇求經理給予全額退款。

en: to continue to exist or keep trying
simple: If the pain persists, see a doctor.
simple_zh: 如果疼痛持續，請看醫生。
toeic: If the problem persists, please contact our support team.
toeic_zh: 如果問題持續，請聯絡我們的支援團隊。
